contact.department: Florida Department of Revenue, Property Tax Oversight (statewide cadastral)

counties.notes: Alachua County (FIPS 12001) is served by the Florida Department of Revenue statewide cadastral layer, filter with CO_NO=11. The layer carries the annual county tax roll and exposes OWN_NAME, OWN_ADDR1/OWN_CITY/OWN_STATE/OWN_ZIPCD for the owner's mailing address, PHY_ADDR1/PHY_CITY/PHY_ZIPCD for the situs address, PARCEL_ID, ALT_KEY, JV, LND_VAL, ACT_YR_BLT, TOT_LVG_AR, DOR_UC and the two most recent sales. CO_NO is an FDOR-internal county number, not a FIPS code; the value above was established by querying this layer at the county's Census internal point and reading back the CO_NO of the parcel there. The county's own Property Appraiser holds the authoritative record, including exemptions and mid-year changes. Two measured limits, both about speed rather than coverage: the layer indexes OBJECTID, PARCEL_ID and geometry but not CO_NO, so an attribute search scoped by county alone scans 10.8 million parcels, while a spatial or PARCEL_ID search does not; and it refuses a query carrying a small resultRecordCount, answering HTTP 200 with a parameter error after about 55 seconds where the same query without that parameter answers in one to nine seconds.
